author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear looks at a brand-new, road-going Ford Escort Mk1 RS. It weighs just 895kg, and the bespoke 2.1-litre engine produces 325bhp and revs to 10,000rpm! Officially licensed by Ford, it’s been engineered by Boreham Motorworks, a sister company to Evoluto, who recently created a Ferrari F355-based restomod. 

🚗 Ford Escort Mk1 RS from Boreham Motorworks
